tags.name: Media
tags.description: Media library on top of Files: metadata (titles, shows, seasons, episodes, genres), probing, posters, playback streams, ffmpeg transcoding, subtitles, watch progress and TMDB lookups.

get.description:
Media items (movie/tv category or video files) across the caller's home and the libraries they can read — other users' homes only with an explicit `space_id` (admins). Keyset pagination; `sort=random` with a `seed` gives a stable shuffled order across pages (a random seed is chosen and kept in the cursor otherwise).

**Scope:** `media:read`

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug or comma list; `none` = no category. Default: `movie`, `tv` and uncategorized video files.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Subcategory slug (or comma list).

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Genre (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Release year.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Show title or show key — episodes of one show.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season number.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search (prefix match on the last word) on title, show, episode title, description and file name.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: File tag (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one space.

parameters.name: watched
parameters.description: Filter by the caller's watched flag (`true`/`false`; omit for all).

parameters.name: in_progress
parameters.description: Only items the caller started but has not finished (for "continue watching").

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key. `episode` = show, season, episode; `progress` = when the caller last watched (use `order=desc`). Missing values sort last.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Seed for `sort=random` (keep it constant while paging).

patch.description:
Updates editable metadata (write access to the space), and optionally the file `category`/`subcategory` and the caller's `watched` flag (read access suffices for `watched` alone). Manually edited values are kept by later auto-tagging unless `overwrite` is requested.

**Scope:** `media:write`

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: File ID of the media item.

post.description:
Applies the same fields (plus file `category`/`subcategory` and the caller's `watched`) to up to 1000 items, e.g. `show_title` and `season` for a folder of episodes. Items that are missing or not writable are reported in `errors`.

**Scope:** `media:write`

Parses file and folder names such as `Show.Name.S01E02.Title.mkv`, `Show Name - 1x02`, `Movie Name (2010).mp4`,
`Movie.Name.2010.1080p.mkv` and `Show/Season 1/…`, and reads Kodi `.nfo` sidecars (`<video>.nfo`, `movie.nfo`, and `tvshow.nfo` in the folder or any parent folder), to fill title, show, season, episode, year, plot, genres, rating and IDs, and sets the file category (`movie/feature` or `tv/episode`) when it is empty. Needs write access to the space; at most 20000 media files per request (422 otherwise). New uploads already get a guess from their file name.

**Scope:** `media:write`

Re-reads duration, dimensions, codecs and subtitle tracks now (`ffprobe` when available, else the pure-Go MP4/MOV, Matroska/WebM, AVI, MPEG-TS and audio parsers) and regenerates the thumbnail when `media.auto_thumbnails` is on. Needs write access to the space. One manual probe per user runs at a time (four server-wide): 429 `rate_limited` with `Retry-After` otherwise. The built-in parsers are bounded in reads and work and give up after 60 s.

**Scope:** `media:write`

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: File ID of the media item.

put.description:
Raw JPEG, PNG or GIF body (at most 20 MiB and 50 megapixels), stored as a normalized JPEG (≤ 1280 px). The format is detected from the content; WebP cannot be decoded and is rejected with 415.

**Scope:** `media:write`

parameters.name: file_id

get.description:
The original bytes with Range/If-Range/ETag support and `Content-Disposition: inline` (sandboxing CSP, `nosniff`) — use when `browser_playable` is true, or for external players. Only media items can be streamed.

**Scope:** `media:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: File ID of the media item.

206.description: Partial content for a satisfiable `Range` request.

get.description:
Transcodes with ffmpeg to H.264/AAC fragmented MP4 starting at `start` seconds, at most `height` lines (never upscaled). Not seekable (no Range): to seek, request again with a new `start`. At most two transcodes run at once server-wide and one per user (a request waits up to 5 s for a slot, e.g. while a seek replaces the previous stream, then gets 429 with `Retry-After`). ffmpeg is stopped when the client disconnects or stops reading for 60 s (a long-paused player must request again with `start` at its position). Needs ffmpeg and `media.transcode_enabled`, otherwise `501 ffmpeg_unavailable`.

**Scope:** `media:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: File ID of the media item.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start position in seconds.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Target height (never upscaled).

get.description:
Sidecar `.srt`/`.vtt`/`.ass` files are converted to WebVTT (styles and markup other than `<b>`/`<i>`/`<u>` are dropped); embedded text tracks are extracted with ffmpeg and cached (501 `ffmpeg_unavailable` without it). Unknown index or an unreadable track: 404.

**Scope:** `media:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: File ID of the media item.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: `index` from `media.subtitles`.

put.description:
Stores the caller's resume position and watched flag (see `completed`). Only needs read scope and read access because it is per-user state.

**Scope:** `media:read`

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: File ID of the media item.

get.description:
Searches The Movie Database with the server's `media.tmdb_api_key` (never exposed; a v3 key or a v4 read access token). 10 s timeout, at most 20 results. 501 when no key is configured, 502 `tmdb_failed` when TMDB fails or rejects the key.

**Scope:** `media:write`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Title to search.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Movie or TV show.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Release / first-air year.

post.description:
Fetches details for `tmdb_id` and fills title, sort title, year, description, genres, US content rating, IMDb/TMDB IDs, poster and backdrop (downloaded, at most 10 MiB each, re-encoded), and sets the category (`movie/feature` or `tv/episode`). For `tv`, the episode title and overview are fetched when the item has a season and episode. Needs write access; 502 `tmdb_failed` on upstream errors, 404 when TMDB does not know the id.

**Scope:** `media:write`

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: File ID of the media item.

get.description:
JPEG backdrop downloaded by TMDB identify (`sm` 480 px, `md` 960 px, `lg` 1920 px wide). 404 when there is none.

**Scope:** `media:read` · also accepts `?access_token=`

index.description: Index used in the subtitle URL.

MediaInfo.description: Media metadata attached to a file.

sort_title.description: Title used for sorting (e.g. without leading "The").

browser_playable.description: MP4/M4V/MOV with H.264/AV1/VP9 + AAC/MP3/Opus, or WebM VP8/VP9/AV1 + Vorbis/Opus. Otherwise use the transcode URL.

poster_url.description: Relative poster URL (custom poster, else the thumbnail when one can be produced) carrying a cache-busting version query (?v=…) that changes with the image; append &size=sm|md|lg.

backdrop_url.description: Relative backdrop URL (set by TMDB identify) with a version query (?v=…); append &size=sm|md|lg.

subtitles.description: Text subtitle tracks: sidecar files next to the video (same base name) first, then embedded text tracks (`format` `embedded`, need ffmpeg). Image-based tracks (PGS, VobSub) are not listed.

show_key.description: Stable key of `show_title` (`[a-z0-9-]`, `""` when not an episode); use with `/api/v1/media/shows/{show_key}`.

last_watched_at.description: When the caller last saved progress for this item (null = never).

probe_status.description: State of technical probing (duration, codecs, subtitles).

MediaItem.description: A file entry with its media metadata.

MediaFacets.description: Filter values with counts for building library filters.

shows.description: Show titles (use `show=` with the title or its key).

show_key.description: Stable key of the show (use in `/api/v1/media/shows/{show_key}`).

poster_url.description: Poster of the first episode with a custom poster, else the first episode's thumbnail.

season.description: Season number; episodes without a season are grouped under 0.

episodes.description: Ordered by episode number, then title.

backdrop_url.description: Backdrop of the first episode that has one.

MediaUpdate.description: Editable media fields. Computed fields (duration, codecs, URLs, …) and unknown fields are ignored. `null` clears nullable fields; an empty `sort_title` is derived from `title`.

sort_title.description: Title used for sorting (e.g. without leading "The").

watched.description: Watched flag of the **caller** (per user; marking watched resets the resume position). Needs only read access to the space.

sort_title.description: Title used for sorting (e.g. without leading "The").

overwrite.description: Replace metadata that was set manually, by TMDB or by an earlier auto-tag. Without it only empty fields are filled (guesses made from the file name at upload are always replaced).

position_seconds.description: Resume position in seconds (clamped to the duration).

completed.description: `true` marks watched and resets the position; `false` clears the watched flag. Omitted: the item becomes watched once the position reaches 90% of the duration (and stays watched).

poster_url.description: Absolute TMDB image URL (informational; the web UI does not load third-party images).

apply_to_show.description: For `type` `tv`: also apply the series (title, overview, genres, rating, poster, backdrop) to the other episodes of the same show in the same space.

errors.description: Items that were not found, not media items or not writable.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. not_found or forbidden.
